messages:
maria-sec: Heads-up — saw something weird in prod authn-proxy logs during yesterday's SAML rollout. Session state (sid) got appended to the ACS redirect querystring and an external idp picked it up. SCIM reconcile shows 7 duplicate emails created for the same user. Tracking as P1 until we confirm blast radius.

raj-iam: omg. any stack traces or logs?

maria-sec: paste logs:
```
[2026-03-20T22:14:03Z] authn-proxy: redirect -> /sso/acs?SAMLResponse=...&sid=abc123&relayState=/app
[2026-03-20T22:14:03Z] downstream-idp: received relayState=/app?sid=abc123
```

emi-sre: that `sid` shouldn't be in relayState. looks like header -> querystring encoder bug when x-forwarded-host == internal. reproduce steps?

maria-sec: repro on staging with curl; command:
```
curl -i -X GET 'https://proxy.staging/redir?SAMLRequest=...&RelayState=/app'
```
we see proxy adding `sid` from session cookie into query.

raj-iam: SCIM duplicates — are they JIT provisioned users? if relayState mutated maybe idp returned different NameID each time.

maria-sec: yes, 7 of 7 were JIT. SCIM reconcile shows created_at bursts at the same minute. audit logs show `create_user` events with different external_id hashes.

sso-bot: Deploy 2026-03-20T22:30:00 by infra/canary — authn-proxy v3.4.2 -> v3.4.3

emi-sre: mitigation: disable JIT provisioning flag for the tenant(s) affected and add a temporary filter in proxy to strip session keys from querystring. Can we do scope-limited change now?

raj-iam: agree; we should also block outbound SCIM create calls for those tenants until we dedupe. I'll put a rate limit + dry-run mode.

maria-sec: I'll open a short incident page and add steps. plan to backfill: use SCIM reconcile job to merge duplicates by email, keep earliest created account, map ext_ids, and rotate KMS envelope for affected external_id derivation key (to prevent replay). ETA 3h for backfill dry-run.

emi-sre: assign -> emi-sre to apply proxy filter; raj-iam to pause SCIM writes; maria-sec to own incident and audit log analysis. I'll prepare a quick patch:
```
// strip session keys
if (req.query.sid) { delete req.query.sid }
```

maria-sec: thanks. also we need to add an audit event for 'relaystate_mutation' and alert on duplicates >3 in 1m. put into console alerts.

raj-iam: done — alert rule created (eng-sre /alerts). tagging security and platform.

maria-sec: @emi-sre please share PR link when ready. next update in 10m.

emi-sre: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/authn-proxy/pull/482 — small filter + unit test. deploying to staging now :thumbsup: 

maria-sec: great. keeping this thread as the coordination log.
